cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only carrying the shopping, but I'm not taking home another sour bunch. Try one of these before we buy them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just one. I'll keep the bunch out of our basket until you tell me it's sweet; then I'll try the next.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but hold it where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it out like samples. You take the first one; if the assistant lets that pass, I'll have mine before we pay.
